displayName: RPG Runner - account deletion stalled or excessive attempts

documentation.content: The repair scan found incomplete account deletion work older than twelve hours or at 400 attempts. Twelve hours accommodates the pre-release 15-minute repair cadence and the multi-board, repeated-reconciliation workflow. Inspect the oldest stage, retryable backlog, page saturation, and repair logs; do not bypass deletion stages.

conditions.displayName: Deletion age or attempt safety bound exceeded
